note: SPECIAL CASE (--AWH): an urban paved RV lot at the Liberty Harbor Marina / Morris Canal Basin in Jersey City - included for its unmatched NYC access (PATH/ferry/light-rail to Manhattan minutes away, plus Statue of Liberty & Liberty State Park), not as a traditional campground. It is a tightly-packed angled-stall parking lot, not a scenic campground. 24/7 self check-in. Front-row sites overlook the marina basin with open Manhattan-skyline views across the water. The operator warns to check your own route for height, weight and propane restrictions. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the operator's site and CampLife: $170 standard / $189 holiday-peak (CampLife $179.96 Nov 2026, $189.31 June 2027 before tax), 30/50-amp electric and seasonal water, open in winter, showers/laundry/WiFi/two dump stations, reservable on CampLife. Changed sewer: none at the sites (operator: 'no individual sewer hookups'); the note's 'full water' and hookup/booking restatements trimmed. Site count ~50 left (CampLife lists 126 units including tent sites; the operator states no count).
flags: Special case kept by AWH for NYC access; the over-gate rate ($170-189) is recorded, not flagged. Gateway: New York metro (3 km, gateways.py). The family has not stayed here.
Good Sam: the operator's Good Sam page says only 'contact the office to confirm any applicable member rate'; the derived good_sam false is left.
